text.A: **Denne erklæringen gjelder uansett hvor du er.** Vi følger britisk personvernlovgivning, og der personvernlovgivningen i landet du bor i, også gjelder, følger vi den også.
text.B: **Merknader om allergier og kosthold.** Vi videreformidler dem til matbilen sammen med bestillingen din og bruker dem ikke til noe annet. Vi fjerner dem, sammen med navnet og kontaktopplysningene dine, 12 måneder etter bestillingen (se punkt 7).
text.C: **Internasjonale overføringer.** Kontoopplysningene og bestillingsopplysningene dine lagres og behandles i Storbritannia. Noe håndteres utenfor Storbritannia: uthenting av menyer og automatiske WhatsApp-svar, som bruker en Google-tjeneste i USA; levering av WhatsApp-meldinger, som håndteres av Meta i USA; betalinger, som håndteres av Stripe i USA; og push-varsler, som leveres av Apple og Google i USA. Der opplysninger forlater Storbritannia, er overføringen dekket av britiske adekvansbestemmelser (UK adequacy regulations) eller av International Data Transfer Agreement eller Addendum (britisk avtale om, eller tillegg for, internasjonal dataoverføring) og, der lovgivningen i landet ditt krever det, av en garanti som den lovgivningen anerkjenner. Du kan be oss om nærmere opplysninger om garantiene som gjelder.
text.G:
[Bruksvilkårene](/terms) våre gjelder i alle land der HatchGrab brukes. Noen land har tilleggsregler. Denne siden beskriver dem, ett land om gangen.

Der et avsnitt nedenfor gjelder for deg, er det en del av bruksvilkårene våre. Hvis det sier noe annet enn de gjør, gjelder denne siden for det landet.

Hvis landet ditt ikke er oppført, finnes det ingen tilleggsregler: Bruksvilkårene gjelder slik de er skrevet. [Personvernerklæringen](/privacy) vår er den samme i alle land.

back.A: **This statement applies wherever you are.** We follow British data protection legislation, and where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we follow that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergies and diet.** We pass them on to the food truck together with your order and use them for nothing else. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see point 7).
back.C: Where data leave the UK, the transfer is covered by British adequacy provisions (UK adequacy regulations) or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum (British agreement on, or addendum for, international data transfer) and, where the legislation of your country requires it, by a safeguard that that legislation recognises.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under British data protection legislation, and the legislation of the country you live in where it applies, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The legislation where you live may give you these rights under other names, or more rights. Those you have too. / **How to send a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We check that the request is genuine before we act on it. You can ask someone to send the request for you, and we do not treat you differently because you send one. We reply within one month, or earlier if the legislation of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request on to that food truck, because it is the one that decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to assess it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the names, contact details and notes of the operator's customers from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the legislation where you live allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each of them states who it is from, contains our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we do, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by text message, you get them only if you consent, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a personal data security breach concerning your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as we can where the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we appreciate getting the chance to put the matter right. You can also complain to the data protection supervisory authority where you live. In the UK that is the Information Commissioner's Office (the British data protection authority), at ico.org.uk or on phone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Use] apply in all countries where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have extra rules. This page describes them, one country at a time. / Where a section below applies to you, it is part of our terms of use. If it says something different from what they do, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no extra rules: the Terms of Use apply as written. Our [Privacy Statement] is the same in all countries.
